observations.why: The speaker performs an adoption decision, but no explicit role or agreed process establishes authority beyond the act itself.
A quantified performance comparison supplies technical expertise and an evidence-based reason for the decision.
A definite future timing imposes a migration schedule, though it does not explicitly threaten a cost.
The memo presents the database choice as an established decision, but the topic-specific wording does not support a named reusable power pattern.
The memo supplies a quantified technical performance claim as evidence for the choice.
The memo fixes a concrete migration deadline, creating schedule pressure without an explicit threatened consequence.
